  reverseWords("hello world") → "olleh dlrow"
  reverseWords("") → ""

hints: explode(' ', $sentence) splits a string into an array of words; implode(' ', $words) joins them back.
array_map('strrev', $words) applies strrev to every element — no loop needed.
solution:
<?php
function reverseWords(string $sentence): string
{
    $words = explode(' ', $sentence);
    $reversed = array_map('strrev', $words);
    return implode(' ', $reversed);
}
